title: Japan: debt securities issued by the general government, all markets, by currency of denomination, nominal value, billions of yen, quarterly, 1997-Q4 to 2026-Q1
source: Bank for International Settlements, BIS Data Portal (dataset WS_NA_SEC_DSS, debt securities statistics)
series: WS_NA_SEC_DSS Q.N.JP.XW.S13.S1.N.L.LE.F3.T._Z.JPY.{c}.N.V.N._T with {c} = _T (all_jpy_bn: all currencies), XDC (domestic_jpy_bn: domestic currency), X1 (foreign_jpy_bn: foreign currency); issued by the general government (S13), all markets, all original maturities, nominal value, stocks, billions of yen
license: BIS Data Portal terms (https://data.bis.org/help/legal, 2026-10-14): 'The use of the statistics is unrestricted, provided that: if the statistics are reproduced, the BIS must be cited in your publication or product as the source of the statistics; if the statistics will be translated into another language, a statement must be included in your publication or product that the translation is not an official BIS translation'. The Chinese labels in the book are not an official BIS translation.
notes: The split by currency starts in 2012-Q1; the column all_jpy_bn starts in 1997-Q4. domestic_jpy_bn + foreign_jpy_bn = all_jpy_bn. Debt securities are part of the general government's debt (loans are the rest; see bis_japan_govcredit).
